entities.summary: Rusudan Khoperia is a Georgian trampoline gymnast who represented Georgia at two Olympic Games, and with the former USSR at the 1988 Trampoline World Championships. She won 3 World gold medals: two with the Soviet team as an individual and as a team member, and one in the synchro event with Elena Kolomeets.
